id: Passage syntax: Section 2.2 catalogue and formal multiple
note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved: The passage defines the catalogue, H_cat, N_s and M0 and asserts that the catalogue terminates, that M0 is a successful index, and that the guard's fixed point coordinates have nonzero denominators; [F] defines all of these as [M] does and proves the three facts unconditionally (infinite_catalogue_class, M0_bounds, iota_eq_psi_unconditional). Two packagings differ: normalizedRep takes c as the lcm of denominators (isNormalizedRep_iff proves it equal to the gcd form), and leastFormalMultiple is 0 when no index succeeds, which M0_bounds excludes; the closing remark asserts nothing.

theorem iota_eq_psi_unconditional :
    (∀ n : ℤ, 1 ≤ n → psiP0 n ≠ 0 ∧
      iota n = ![0, (fixedX n).re, (fixedX n).im, (fixedY n).re, (fixedY n).im] ∧
      iota (-n) = ![0, (fixedX n).re, (fixedX n).im, -(fixedY n).re, -(fixedY n).im]) ∧
    iota 0 = ![1, 0, 0, 0, 0] :=
